title: Sponsor a Programme
intro: Local businesses help us give young people in Darlington chances they'd otherwise never get. Choose a programme, pick a package, and we'll show you exactly what your support made possible.

story.heading: Why we do this
story.text: A young man we work with had lived in the shadow of Roseberry Topping his whole life and never once been up it. No car to get there, no one to climb it with, no one to show him where to start. A few weeks into one of our outdoor courses, we stood on the top together. Sponsors make days like that possible.

benefits: An impact summary for your CSR reporting
The option of an outdoor staff volunteering day
cicNote: As a community interest company, a third of our profit goes straight back into the community.

programmes.name: Creatureverse: Rift Battles
programmes.summary: A hands-on creative programme where young people design their own creatures, turn them into 3D-printed models, create trading cards and custom packaging, then battle them in a final tournament. Learners work towards an AQA Unit Award Scheme (UAS) award. We arrange dates once the cohort is formed.
programmes.imageAlt: Creatureverse creatures at every stage: a hand-drawn sketch, a 3D model on a laptop, painted 3D-printed figures, boxed collectibles and trading cards

packages.name: Sole sponsor
packages.funds: Funds 10 learners for the full programme and their AQA UAS award. Exclusive branding as lead partner.
packages.label: Lead partner

packages.name: Co-sponsor
packages.funds: Two sponsors, two teams: supports 10 learners together, with shared branding and partnership.

programmes.packagesNote: Parents and carers book places and complete consent separately. Sponsors never need to give us any learner details.
benefits: Your brand on all course materials: posters, cards, packaging and website
A sponsor spotlight: interview and promotional content
Recognition at the final tournament, including judging and the award presentation
Promotion across our website and social media, reaching local families, schools and youth groups
The chance to have a display or pop-up at the tournament

programmes.name: Outdoor Resilience & Mentoring
programmes.summary: Outdoor mental health and resilience courses for young people who'd otherwise never get the chance, plus one-to-one mentoring for young adults making the uncertain move from school to work.
programmes.imageAlt: Young people taking part in an outdoor activity session

packages.name: Kit and lunch
packages.funds: Covers kit and lunch for a group

packages.name: One young person
packages.funds: A full outdoor mental health day for one young person, plus ongoing support

packages.name: Mentoring
packages.funds: Six 1:1 mentoring sessions for a young adult, with clinical supervision from a Clinical Psychologist

packages.name: Group day
packages.funds: Takes a group of 6 out for the day. They leave with new confidence, soft skills and an AQA certificated award for their CV

programmes.name: ECO//FUTURE
programmes.summary: Help ten home-educated young people design and build a more sustainable home. Over ten weekly two-hour sessions, learners work from a client brief: they decide where to place solar panels, work out how much rainwater a roof could collect, and turn their drawings into a physical scale model. At the final showcase they present their home and explain the decisions behind it. Once the cohort is fully funded, places are free for families, with materials and equipment included.
programmes.imageAlt: Scale model homes made from card and foam board, one with a solar panel and a rainwater butt, beside a hand-drawn floor plan

packages.name: Lead sponsor
packages.funds: All ten places, with recognition as the lead programme partner.
packages.label: Lead partner

packages.name: Co-sponsor
packages.funds: Five places, with shared recognition when a second partner funds the other five.

programmes.packagesNote: Funding covers staff time, workshop materials, digital design and 3D printing, learner support, assessment and the final showcase. Learners can work towards an AQA Unit Award Scheme certificate, subject to unit validation and achieving the required outcomes. Work in construction, architecture, renewable energy or building supplies? We'd love to show you what learners will make.
